description: Converts a vMIDI stream to three control voltages, either as one voice of note pitch, gate and velocity or as three chosen controller numbers

params.text: Starts learning; in the note modes the next channel message to arrive sets the receive channel, and in CC mode each press steps to the next output, whose lamp flashes until a controller moves
Chooses which of the three voices this module converts when MODE is at PLY, 1 being the first voice; it does nothing at MNO or CC
Chooses what the three outputs carry: MNO converts notes one at a time with last-note priority, PLY converts one voice of a three-voice chord, CC converts three chosen controller numbers

inputs.text: Takes the vMIDI stream converted to voltages here

outputs.text: The pitch of the note, one volt per octave with note 60 at 0V and pitch bend added; in CC mode the first learned controller instead, -5V at 0 to 5V at 127
10V while a note is held and 0V once it is released, with the damper pedal holding it up; in CC mode the second learned controller instead, -5V at 0 to 5V at 127
The velocity of the note, -5V at 0 rising to 5V at 127; in CC mode the third learned controller instead, over the same range

notes: notes below 12 or above 115 are thrown away before anything is converted
for three-voice polyphony put three of these side by side, set MODE to PLY on all of them, feed them the same vMIDI stream and give each a different VOICE setting
learning gives up 4 seconds after the button is pressed if nothing arrives; the maker's comment beside that timeout says 2 seconds and is wrong
pitch and gate are smoothed with a 0.1ms time constant and the CC outputs with a 10ms one, so a CC output slews to each new value
menu: Pitch Bend Range — sets how far a full pitch bend moves the pitch output, the choices reading 1 semitones through 12 semitones; a new module comes up at 2

outputs.0: 1V per octave · continuous · one channel only
